task: Define the mission and fundraising decision rights
completion_evidence: Approved mission brief names the fundraising lead, target audience and authorized decision makers.

task: Map sponsors, donors and the volunteer team
completion_evidence: Foundation approves who can contact each group, what may be shared and who already owns the relationship.

task: Agree the Cause on Cue support scope
completion_evidence: Written support agreement records eligible services, VNV and foundation responsibilities, exclusions and approvals.

task: Define sponsor benefits and the story onstage
completion_evidence: Approved benefits list, mission program, host and sponsor acknowledgments. Each item has an owner.
Primary and companion test records can be found and checked in separately by the authorized roles.

task: Set up sponsor, donor and volunteer records
completion_evidence: Permissions tested. Volunteer assignments, sponsor benefits and approved donor records are visible to their owners.

task: Brief vendors, volunteer captains and speakers
completion_evidence: Approved run of show includes the fundraising moment, sponsor cues, check-in points and volunteer relief.

task: Open guest check-in and verify volunteer posts
completion_evidence: Access desk validates individual arrivals and captains acknowledge the positions actually covered.

task: Fulfill sponsor benefits and run the fundraising program
completion_evidence: Approved recognition delivered and documented. Donation communications follow the foundation's directions.
Authorized decision makers receive attendance, agreed sponsor fulfillment and aggregate fundraising results.

task: Return materials and agree the next contact
completion_evidence: Foundation approves the recap and any requested introductions, with named owners and dated follow-ups.
